---
title: "Pico"
subtitle: "Building your first Pico."

Welcome to **Pico**, the reference course of the Open Engineering Academy.
This course teaches how to design and build your first Pico — a small,
declarative, composable engineering artifact — and doubles as the canonical
example for how every academy course website is structured.

## Where this course fits

Pico is the academy's **behaviour** layer. The three-layer story is:

> **Crossplane composes**, **Sandcastle constructs**, **Picos behave**.

This course teaches what a Pico *does* at runtime — how a `hello-world-pico`
receives events, evaluates rules, and produces actions. Its sibling courses
teach the other two layers:

- [Crossplane course](../crossplane/index.html) — declares and composes what
  should exist on a control plane.
- [Sandcastle course](../sandcastle/index.html) — the bounded engineering
  environment inside which artifacts like Picos are safely built.

Pico is the foundation for the other two: complete this course first so you
know what a durable Pico artifact looks like before you compose it with
Crossplane or construct it inside a Sandcastle.

## What you will learn

By the end of the course you will be able to:

- Explain what a Pico is and how it fits into Open Engineering.
- Author Rules, a Parser, and a Composer for a minimal Pico.
- Produce a working `hello-world-pico` and describe it with metadata.

See the course descriptor in [`metadata.yaml`](metadata.yaml) for the
machine-readable summary (id, level, duration, prerequisites, teaches,
produces).

## How this course is structured

The course is organized into **parts**, each part into **lessons**, and each
lesson into a consistent set of pages:

```
courses/pico/
  _quarto.yml          # this course website
  index.qmd            # you are here
  metadata.yaml        # machine-readable course descriptor
  glossary.qmd         # course glossary
  part-1/              # section
    index.qmd
    01-introduction/   # lesson
      index.qmd
      exercise.qmd
      lab.qmd
      summary.qmd
      quiz.qmd
      assets/
  part-2/
  part-3/
  labs/                # course-scoped labs
  assets/              # course-scoped assets
```
